hero.subtitle: Websites, billing and accounts software, custom ERPs and full apps for growing businesses. Built faster with AI, held to the standards of {years}+ years in professional IT.

contact.location: Tamil Nadu, India · working with clients India-wide

journey.title: Where it started
journey.text: Built service-tracking software for Sakthi Mobiles, a local mobile shop. My first paying client.

journey.title: First referral
journey.text: Their business partner needed invoicing for a textile brand. That became Eclipse, still growing three years on.

journey.title: Same idea, new business
journey.text: Adapted the invoice system for Pandeeswari Polymers, a manufacturer with different billing rules.

journey.title: They came back, twice
journey.text: Sakthi Mobiles asked for a recharge platform for its branches, then an accounts system to track daily profit.

journey.title: Mainext Innovations
journey.text: Gave the work a name, built the Texora International website and launched my own product, GrowMate.

journey.title: Bigger systems
journey.text: Inventory for Sakthi, an operations platform for NSL, the RVS Holidays website and a full contracting ERP for AC&CO.

journey.title: AI-first
journey.text: Every build runs on an AI-assisted workflow: requirements, code and tests. All client apps run on servers I manage.
